answer: The acquired-artifact injection gate caught every planted class (role-spoof, ignore-previous, base64-exec, bundled-agent-config), including bundled .claude and .codex configs. A documentation quote of those strings was not flagged. Neutralisation preserved mechanism_id/stage_id tokens and left source files in place. A downstream extraction consumer that obeys unfenced canaries and auto-loads ungated agent config did not change behaviour on gated artefacts; the same consumer on the ungated plants did. SUCCESS:WFA-0121

content_preservation.description: Neutralisation copies a wrapped tree. Deleting the file is not neutralization.

sensitive_diff.description: A legitimate mechanism_id edit on a clean workflow changes extracted tokens, proving the consumer is not a no-op.

use_versus_mention.description: A README that quotes injection strings for documentation must not be flagged and must not fire the canary.

evidence.claim: Planted role-spoof, ignore-previous-instructions, base64 exec, and bundled .claude/.codex configs are each detected and wrapped.

gate.rule: Acquired workflow definitions, transcripts and marketplace packages are untrusted DATA. Instruction USE is wrapped in a structural [[UNTRUSTED-DATA]] fence. Mention inside backticks or documentation quotes is not USE. Bundled .claude/.codex configs are tagged and never auto-loaded. Files are not deleted.

negative_controls.description: Disable the gate and feed the planted artefact to the consumer; canary or autoload MUST fire.

negative_controls.bad_state_output: USE findings on a planted ignore-previous file
negative_controls.description: Documentation quoting injection strings stays silent.

notes: G-1 delivery of WFA-0121. Live named probes measure payload-class catch plus independent downstream behaviour. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud ok is not consulted. No ADV rebuild. SUCCESS:WFA-0121
question_or_target: Implementation target: a gate that neutralises instruction-shaped content inside acquired workflow definitions, transcripts and marketplace packages before any downstream stage reads them - covering the spec's named class in which a council transcript or participant artifact injects instructions into a later stage.

residual_unknowns.claim: WFA-0020/0023/0024 sweep-lane artefacts are not on disk. This unit gates a planted corpus that stands in for those acquired surfaces (transcript, marketplace package, workflow definition). Live sweep bytes were not re-fetched.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: When those sweep reports land, run neutralise_tree over their captured blobs and require the same consumer side-effects to stay clean.

residual_unknowns.claim: WFA-0001 wfa-schema-pack.json is absent, so this RegressionFixture was not validated by python-jsonschema 2020-12 against the pack $def.

reviewer.obligation: Attempt the named bypass (ungated plant reaching the consumer) and fail to achieve it against the gated artefact. Re-run the both-states control before PASS.

schema_note: WFA-0001 schema pack is not on disk in this worktree. This record is a RegressionFixture-shaped gate report; pack-level validation is residual until WFA-0001 lands. That residual is not claimed as PASS.
title: Treat every acquired workflow artifact as untrusted data and gate it against prompt injection
